title: useSpaceState
description: `useSpaceState` notes the last page of the page's space on each address, in `lathe:space-pages`.

title: usePageTabs
description: `usePageTabs` moves the active tab with `moveInTab` on each address it did not set itself.

title: usePageTabs.change
description: `change` in `usePageTabs` moves the address to the active tab's after an activate, a new tab or a close, and rewrites the window's history to that tab's entries (app/src/views/tabHistory.ts).

title: startApp
description: `openFolder` calls `startApp` as its last step once the window is open (Retry calls it again): it starts the folder's server when the window has none, with `startDev` in development or else `startServe` on the product's own installed Lathe or the bundled copy, then loads its URL under the launch view; a failure shows the error page.

title: stopServer
description: `stopServer`, from the closed, before-quit, SIGINT and SIGTERM handlers that stop servers.

title: rememberRecent
description: In `openFolder`, once the folder checks and before its window opens: `addRecent` puts it first, `rememberRecent` writes recent-folders.json and rebuilds the menu, and `app.addRecentDocument` adds it to the system's recent documents.
